tools.description: Read a vault doc by file_path; chunk_id (from a search row) reads one heading's block, section= a heading by name, start_line/end_line a line range. max_chars caps the text; truncated=True means more remains: narrow the read. fields= trims keys.
tools.name: get_document

tools.description: Hybrid search (mode hybrid|semantic|keyword); score is ordinal, not a probability. fields= adds chunk_id, section for get_document; snippet=True an excerpt; include_memories=True adds memories. rerank='on': vault judge, rerank_score a probability.
tools.name: search

tools.description: Filter docs by frontmatter type, service, tag (e.g. service/middleware) and status, AND-ed. limit/offset page the rows; facets=True returns the values that exist instead of documents. fields= trims rows.
tools.name: search_by_metadata

tools.description: search expanded through wiki-links up to depth hops (max 3); discovered_via says how each row was reached. Same fields= and snippet= as search.
tools.name: search_deep

tools.description: Shortest wiki-link path between two docs, links in either direction, up to max_depth hops (1-6). weighted=True prefers learned links. Ties resolve to the lexicographically smallest path.
tools.name: find_path

tools.description: Docs linked from or to a doc, strongest learned links first, ties by path. include_suggested=True adds unlinked docs sharing two or more neighbors. fields= trims rows.
tools.name: get_related

tools.description: Curation report: unlinked doc pairs that share graph neighbors, by confidence. Pure graph math, no API cost.
tools.name: suggest_links

tools.description: Docs due for revalidation and the owning team (owner, owner_source). reason: overdue (age_days past type threshold), last_updated_invalid (include_unreadable=False drops it) or, with missing_last_updated=True, last_updated_missing. owner= filters.
tools.name: get_stale_docs

tools.description: Auth-flow steps for a provider plus the shared login steps.
tools.name: get_flow

tools.description: Diff two providers' auth flows: common steps, steps only in each, shared login steps.
tools.name: compare_flows

tools.description: Docs that reference this one through backlinks, per depth, sorted by path. max_items caps each list; counts=True adds per-depth totals.
tools.name: get_impact

tools.description: Report vault files under scope_prefix (default Conventions/) whose Confluence page is newer; files outside it are listed. Read-only: dry_run=False is E_WRITE_FENCED; use `cloudfrog-knowledge confluence export`. space_key, page_id ignored.
tools.name: sync_confluence

tools.description: Retired (ADR-039): returns a redirect to graphify, rg and search.
tools.name: search_code

tools.description: Re-index the vault by file hash; only target='vault'. force=True re-embeds every file (a paid full embedding run; needed to backfill new metadata). pull=False skips git; vault_sync says pulled, up_to_date, skipped or failed.
tools.name: reindex

tools.description: Best sections for query under a hard token budget (budget_tokens 500-12000), deduplicated; dropped lists what did not fit. include_memories=True adds memory-folder docs and, when configured, the memory server.
tools.name: context_pack

tools.description: Vaults this server serves (slug, name, default, features) and the tool contract version. Pass a slug as vault= to any tool.
tools.name: list_vaults

tools.description: Admin. Mirror the issues of the vault's integrations.jira projects into memory tasks (upsert by jira_key). dry_run=True (default) only reads Jira; since= ISO date or -7d.
tools.name: sync_jira
